Tourty Prototype

tourtyhappiness sorted

Clickable prototype of the tourist app and the team's portal. Everything runs on demo data in your browser.

  1. Sign up on the phone with any email
  2. Ask for help with your visa or driving permit
  3. Plan your route on the map and book it
  4. Add things to do and choose a car
  5. Work the requests in the portal and watch the phone
